installedDerivation: Not captured from a live install (no container runtime in the review sandbox). Derived the way apk-tools 3.0.8 writes lib/apk/db/installed: the signed index record, r: from the package .PKGINFO replaces, then F:/R:/a:/Z: from the data tar and its APK-TOOLS.checksum.SHA1 PAX records. The control SHA1 equals the index C: and the data sha256 equals the .PKGINFO datahash. Checked on the pinned base: the identity lines of its 7 unchanged packages equal the index record plus r:/q:, and the same rule rebuilds its 20260909-r0 file section byte for byte.
